messages:
hana: Quick heads-up from support: a few onboarding snippets are out of sync and causing copy/paste failures. Most common: curl multiline breaks on paste, Go example calls old Client.Generate, and Java sample still uses chat.send() (NoSuchMethod).
hana: Example problematic curl in README (multiline that gets soft-wrapped on GitHub):
hana: ```
curl https://api.redwood.example/v1/responses \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" \
  -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```

hana: Users are pasting into PowerShell/cmd/fish and getting 401s or syntax errors. Also saw a support thread where Go users hit "undefined: client.Generate" because the SDK now exposes responses.Create.

liam: Oof. Proposal: replace multiline with a one-line cross-shell curl, add explicit cmd and PowerShell variants, and update Go/Java snippets to the new responses.create API. Small Troubleshooting note about shell var syntax (bash/zsh: $VAR, fish: ${VAR}, cmd: %VAR%, PowerShell: $env:VAR).

liam: One-liner I suggest: 
liam: ```
curl -sS --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' https://api.redwood.example/v1/responses --data-raw '{\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```

liam: Windows cmd variant: 
liam: ```
set REDWOOD_API_KEY=your_key_here
curl -sS --header \"Content-Type: application/json\" --header \"Authorization: Bearer %REDWOOD_API_KEY%\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/responses --data-raw \"{\\\"input\\\":\\\"hello\\\"}\"
```

liam: Go snippet update: 
liam: ```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv(\"REDWOOD_API_KEY\"))
resp, err := client.Responses.Create(ctx, redwood.ResponseRequest{Input: \"hello\"})
```

hana: Sounds good. Can you open the PR and tag me? I can run the staging deploy once merged.

docs-bot: Created issue #9123: \"docs: quickstart - replace multiline curl, add shell variants, and update Go/Java SDK snippets to responses.create\" - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/9123 :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Linked support tickets #8342 and #8347 (curl paste failures) to issue #9123.

liam: Opening PR now, will include brief \"If paste fails\" troubleshooting note and examples for fish/PowerShell/cmd.

hana: Thanks 44D will review once CI is green.
